description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'EntityFinderUtil' which provides methods and inner classes for constructing entity conditions, managing query output options such as limits and views, and handling entity list iteration and results within the Apache OFBiz framework. The class handles creation of conditions from XML, expands field mappings, and manages how query results are returned or processed.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil
classes.description: Utility class for constructing entity conditions, managing query result options, and handling entity list processing within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.Condition
classes.description: Interface defining a method to create an EntityCondition based on context, model entity, and field type reader.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.ConditionExpr
classes.description: Represents a single condition expression parsed from XML, capable of creating an EntityCondition object.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.ConditionList
classes.description: Represents a list of conditions combined with a logical operator ('and'/'or'), constructed from XML.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.ConditionObject
classes.description: Represents a condition based on a dynamic field name extracted from context, producing an EntityCondition.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.OutputHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling the output of entity queries, with implementations for various strategies.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.LimitRange
classes.description: Handles limiting query results based on a start position and size, either via partial list or list subsetting.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.LimitView
classes.description: Handles limiting query results based on a view index and size, supporting paged views.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.UseIterator
classes.description: Output handler that exposes the EntityListIterator directly to the caller.

classes.name: EntityFinderUtil.GetAll
classes.description: Collects and returns the full result list or iterator from a query.

methods.name: makeFieldMap
methods.description: Constructs a map of FlexibleMapAccessor objects to values based on XML element configuration.

methods.name: expandFieldMapToContext
methods.description: Expands a field map into the output context, processing FlexibleMapAccessors and string expanders.

methods.name: makeSelectFieldExpanderList
methods.description: Creates a list of FlexibleStringExpander objects for select field XML elements.

methods.name: makeFieldsToSelect
methods.description: Generates a set of field names to select based on expanders and context.

methods.name: makeOrderByFieldList
methods.description: Creates a list of field names for ordering based on expanders and context.

methods.name: createCondition
methods.description: Method within ConditionExpr to create an EntityCondition from given context and model info.

methods.name: createCondition
methods.description: Method within ConditionList to combine child conditions into a composite EntityCondition.

methods.name: createCondition
methods.description: Method within ConditionObject to produce an EntityCondition from context based on a dynamic field reference.

methods.name: getStart
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the start index for result limiting, from context.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the size for limiting query results, from context.

methods.name: handleOutput
methods.description: Various implementations handle the query output results, such as limiting, iteration, or full list collection.
